findings.claim: Authors' interpretation: surface bromide is replaced by phosphonate.
Authors' interpretation: phosphonate bound to the surface.

structural_constraints.value: ligands replace surface bromide (ligands occupy surface Br sites)
structural_constraints.derivation: The Br/Pb atomic ratio decreases from 2.9 to 2.6 after treatment; the authors conclude that surface bromide is replaced by phosphonate.
P 2p peak at 133.2 eV after treatment. Together with the FTIR band changes (FTIR:O1, FTIR:O2; evidence E3, E4) it supports phosphonate oxygens binding surface Pb.
